long_description: An MCP server for the Cloudinary Video API. Manage RTMP live streams and their outputs, generate videos from images, run AI video analysis, and build Video Canvas transformation applets.
name: @cloudinary/video-mcp

api_key.description: Your Cloudinary API key. Found in Dashboard → Settings → Access Keys.
api_key.title: API Key

api_secret.description: Your Cloudinary API secret. Found in Dashboard → Settings → Access Keys.
api_secret.title: API Secret

cloud_name.description: Your Cloudinary cloud name. Find it in your Cloudinary Dashboard.
cloud_name.title: Cloud Name

tools.name: video-canvas-list-video-canvas-applets
tools.description:
List applets

Returns the account's saved Video Canvas applets as summaries, without their inputs, blocks, connections, or outputs.

tools.name: video-canvas-create-video-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Create an applet

Creates an applet from its content (inputs, blocks, connections, and outputs). Cloudinary compiles the action blocks into a named transformation and returns the stored applet.

tools.name: video-canvas-get-video-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Get an applet

Returns a single applet with its full content, including its inputs, blocks, connections, and outputs.

tools.name: video-canvas-update-video-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Replace an applet's content

Replaces the full content of an existing applet and recompiles its backing named transformation.

tools.name: video-canvas-delete-video-canvas-applet
tools.description:
Delete an applet

Deletes an applet and its stored content. The named transformation that backs the applet isn't deleted, so delivery URLs and SDK calls that reference it keep working. To stop delivering the transformation, delete the named transformation separately.

tools.description: Get a list of live streams

tools.name: live-stream-create-live-stream
tools.description: Create a new live stream

tools.name: live-stream-get-live-stream
tools.description: Get a single live stream

tools.name: live-stream-update-live-stream
tools.description: Update a live stream

tools.name: live-stream-delete-live-stream
tools.description: Delete a live stream

tools.name: live-stream-activate-live-stream
tools.description: Manually activate a live stream

tools.name: live-stream-idle-live-stream
tools.description: Manually idle a live stream

tools.name: live-stream-get-live-stream-outputs
tools.description: Get a list of live stream outputs

tools.name: live-stream-create-live-stream-output
tools.description: Create a new live stream output

tools.name: live-stream-get-live-stream-output
tools.description: Get a single live stream output

tools.name: live-stream-update-live-stream-output
tools.description: Update a live stream output

tools.name: live-stream-delete-live-stream-output
tools.description: Delete a live stream output

tools.name: video-generate-create-video-generate-job
tools.description:
Create a video generation job

Submits an image and prompt for video generation and returns a job you can poll for the result.

tools.name: video-generate-get-video-generate-job-status
tools.description:
Poll a video generation job

Returns the current status of a generation job. When the status is `completed`, the response includes the generated video's asset details and delivery URL.

tools.name: image-to-video-prompts-get-image-to-video-prompts
tools.description:
Get a list of image to video prompts

Returns all saved image-to-video prompts for your product environment.

tools.name: image-to-video-prompts-create-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Create an image to video prompt

Saves a reusable prompt with a display name so you can apply it to future generations.

tools.name: image-to-video-prompts-get-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Get an image to video prompt

Returns a single saved prompt by its ID.

tools.name: image-to-video-prompts-update-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Update an image to video prompt

Updates the display name and/or prompt text of a saved prompt.

tools.name: image-to-video-prompts-delete-image-to-video-prompt
tools.description:
Delete an image to video prompt

Permanently deletes a saved prompt by its ID.

tools.name: AI-video-analysis-create-AI-video-analysis-job
tools.description:
Create an AI Video Analysis job

Submits a stored video asset for visual analysis and returns a job you can poll for the result.

tools.name: AI-video-analysis-get-AI-video-analysis-job-status
tools.description:
Poll an AI Video Analysis job

Returns the current status of an analysis job. When the status is `completed`, the response includes the generated visual transcript file's asset details and delivery URL.
